recipe.visualDefinition: A vintage-style square composition featuring a central photographic panel framed by a thick cyan border, set against a white outer margin. The photography uses a triple-exposure effect of a male figure in a suit and sunglasses, illuminated by warm orange and cool magenta stage lighting against a dark, textured background. The top margin contains two distinct typographic elements: one using a multi-colored stenciled effect and the other a bold, high-contrast slab serif.
coreVisualRelationships: Cyan frame acts as a high-contrast barrier between the dark photo and white margin.
Triple exposure creates a rhythmic diagonal movement from left to right.
Warm orange highlights on the primary subject contrast with deep magenta shadows on the secondary figures.
Stenciled type mirrors the 'patchwork' concept through color variation in the letter backgrounds.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Triple-exposure subject occupies 80% of the central framed area, oriented diagonally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The rightmost, most brightly lit figure in the orange suit.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the top-left stenciled text, moves across the top margin to the name, then drops into the cyan frame following the diagonal line of the three figures.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample white space in the outer margins; deep black negative space within the photographic frame.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the cyan border; high value contrast between the white margin and the dark central photo.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif with vertical stress
letterConstructionRules: High stroke contrast between thick verticals and thin horizontals
Stencil effect applied to the left-hand display text using alternating colored boxes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the left-hand title are placed inside individual colored rectangles (yellow, pink, cyan) with a stenciled knockout effect.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Matching slab serif skeletons with different stylistic treatments (stencil vs. clean).
graphicDevices: Colored background boxes for stencil letters

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast slab serif style of the era.
Captures the condensed, heavy slab aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square image with a thick white outer margin and a thick cyan inner border. Inside the border, place a triple-exposure photograph of a man in a suit and sunglasses against a dark background. Use orange gel lighting on the rightmost figure and magenta/blue gels on the two trailing exposures to the left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase slab serif text in the top margin. On the left, place the text inside small alternating colored boxes (yellow, pink, cyan) with a stencil effect. On the right, place the text in a clean, high-contrast black slab serif.

verificationChecks: Is there a clear cyan border separating the photo from the white margin?
Does the photo feature three overlapping exposures of the same subject?
Is the lighting distinctly orange and magenta?
Are the fonts heavy slab serifs?

adjustableVariables: Colors of the stencil background boxes
Intensity of the triple exposure overlap
Specific gel colors for the lighting
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or titles
Record label logos in the corners
Specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Clear separation of layout zones (margin vs. frame)

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the cyan border is a solid, vibrant hue.
Verify the triple exposure creates a clear sense of motion.
Check that the stencil text is legible despite the colored boxes.
Confirm the overall square aspect ratio typical of vinyl covers.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a multi-exposure gel-lit portrait with a rigid geometric frame and high-contrast slab serif typography for a classic soul/R&B aesthetic.
